main_body: Metal/steel-blue panelled wall face (sci-fi bulkhead) with an orange stripe near the top, riveted panels, two orange shelf bars and a vent grille, and a dark skirting at the bottom
top_band: none; the wall is a flat vertical face. The orange stripe at rows 5-6 is a vertical trim band, not a horizontal top surface
evidence: The tile is a wall face for the terrain kind, drawn as a straight front elevation. Panels, rivets, shelf bars and the vent are painted on the vertical face with only thin 1-2px lines for edges. There is no top surface band to read as a horizontal plane. For terrain wall-face tiles this is a flat face with no 3/4 top, so by the strict contract it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has large flat slate-blue panel fills (about 10x10 px) with only a few rivet dots, and 2-3 tones per material. The dark separators are nearly neutral dark blue-grey lines. The Beodeul references carry plaster speckle, per-stone shading, timber grain and window detail across every tile. The candidate's tiles are mostly 2-4 colours, so it reads thinner and flatter than the references.
